import random
import sys

seed = int(sys.stdin.readline())
rng = random.Random(seed)
alphabet = "abc"[:rng.randint(1, 3)]
if rng.random() < 0.5:
    block = "".join(rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 4)))
    n = rng.randint(1, 14)
    s = list((block * n)[:n])
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        p = rng.randrange(n)
        s[p] = rng.choice("abc")
    print("".join(s))
else:
    n = rng.randint(1, 14)
    print("".join(rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(n)))

import random

rng = random.Random(20260926)
n = 100000
while True:
    block = "".join(rng.choice("abc") for _ in range(7))
    if len(set(block)) > 1:
        break
s = list((block * (n // len(block) + 1))[:n])
for p in rng.sample(range(n // 2, n), 20):
    s[p] = rng.choice([c for c in "abc" if c != s[p]])
print("".join(s))
